headline.zh: 为小型企业匹配健康保险方案
headline.en: Match health plans for small business

scenario.zh: 一家15人科技初创公司需要为团队选择合适的健康保险方案
scenario.en: A 15-person tech startup needs to select health coverage for the team

instruction.zh: 选择企业类型以匹配持证顾问
instruction.en: Choose business type to match with licensed adviser

output.zh: 已配对持证顾问李明,专注科技行业,将分析加州市场方案
output.en: Matched with licensed adviser Ming Lee, tech-focused, analyzing CA market options

output.zh: 已配对持证顾问Sara Chen,专注零售业,将分析德州市场方案
output.en: Matched with licensed adviser Sara Chen, retail-focused, analyzing TX market options

instruction.zh: 设定企业预算范围和员工关注重点
instruction.en: Set company budget range and employee priorities

label.zh: 中等预算,重视心理健康福利

output.zh: AI代理已从8家保险公司筛选出4个符合预算的方案,包含远程心理咨询
output.en: AI agent filtered 4 plans from 8 carriers within budget, includes telehealth counseling

label.zh: 紧张预算,重视基础医疗覆盖

output.zh: AI代理已从8家保险公司筛选出3个高性价比基础方案,自付额适中
output.en: AI agent filtered 3 cost-effective base plans from 8 carriers, moderate deductibles

instruction.zh: 查看AI代理生成的并排对比分析
instruction.en: Review side-by-side comparison generated by AI agent

output.zh: 网络范围更广,适合分布式团队,月费较高但自付额低
output.en: Wider network for distributed team, higher monthly but lower deductible

output.zh: 综合医疗体系,月费较低,适合集中办公团队
output.en: Integrated care system, lower monthly, suited for co-located team

instruction.zh: 确认方案并启动投保流程
instruction.en: Confirm plan and initiate enrollment process

output.zh: AI代理已向保险公司提交投保申请,顾问将在48小时内跟进员工注册事宜
output.en: AI agent submitted enrollment to carrier, adviser will follow up on employee sign-ups within 48h

label.zh: 请顾问进一步解释覆盖细节
label.en: Request adviser to clarify coverage details

output.zh: 持证顾问已安排视频会议,将详细讲解两个方案的报销流程和特殊条款
output.en: Licensed adviser scheduled video call to explain reimbursement process and special terms in both plans

takeaway.zh: Corridor结合持证顾问专业判断与AI代理的自动化比较投保,为小型企业提供大企业级保险服务体验
takeaway.en: Corridor pairs licensed adviser expertise with AI agent automation for carrier comparison and enrollment, bringing enterprise-grade benefits service to small businesses
